svg.title: For a scalar multiple av, the Hilbert norm bound is |a|√QvD2n. A finite linear combination has (ST1) by the triangle inequality, with constant equal to the corresponding finite sum. Hence a diagonal estimate on individual words really does produce a bounded operator on their entire dense span. This proves the slab operator construction without assuming boundedness beforehand. To obtain (ST3) in a character chamber, let U be the slab operator in the unselected chamber and let Xv be its ground-space word map. Concatenation says
